主要内容: On February 24, 2016, KENTUCKY BANCSHARES, INC. announced its quarterly cash dividend to shareholders. The dividend amount was set at 27 cents per share, representing an increase from the previous quarter's 26 cents per share. The dividend payment was scheduled to be made on March 31, 2016, to shareholders of record as of March 15, 2016. This announcement was included in an exhibit as a press release dated February 24, 2016. The company's Chief Financial Officer, Gregory J. Dawson, signed the report on behalf of the registrant.
